intro:
This document is generated. Do not edit it by hand. To change it, edit the CSV files in ui_blueprint/ (pairs.csv, behavior.csv, help.csv) or the HTML and the translations, then run build_ui_help_md.mjs.

The window has four areas, and each has its own tab on the settings page. The first-run setup at startup is a part-only area: it is not one of the four, and it has no settings tab and no eye button. Right-clicking a window part and choosing "Open settings for this item" opens the settings card that controls it. Parts without a settings card do not offer this item.

AreaSettings tabCovers
HeaderTitle BarTitle bar, menus, and the theme, language and zoom controls
Editor and toolbarEditorEditing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat
Suggestion sidebarSidebarKnowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots
Bottom bar and systemSystemThe log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice
First-run setup—The three steps at startup. There is no settings tab and no eye button

A setting and a part of the window relate in one of three ways.

RelationMeaning
LinkedThe window has a control for the same value; changing either one updates the other
ReflectedThe window has no control for it, but the setting changes how the window looks or behaves
Settings onlyThe window has no matching part

Each part of the window can be shown or hidden with its eye button under "Parts of the window" on the System tab. Essential parts cannot be hidden.

Help (hdr:menu-help)

Mouse wheel downZooms out one step (down to a limit)

Theme

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
AppearanceMatch system, light or dark. The theme shows its light or dark face.LinkedAppearance mode button (header)
ThemeSwitch color palette and titlebar theme.
Popup colourColour of the popups that appear when you select text (copy and paste), the right-click menu, and the tooltip shown when you hover over a button. Invert shows them on a dark surface in light mode and a light surface in dark mode, so they stand out from the window.
TooltipsShow the tooltip when you hover over a button, with no delay. Off uses the standard tooltip of the system instead.
Tooltip widthLine length of the tooltip shown when you hover over a button. Short wraps long text onto two lines; Long lets a line run wider.
Scrollbar sizeWidth of the scrollbars. A wide bar shows that content is hidden.

Tooltip distanceDistance between the pointer and the tooltip shown when you hover over a button. Near keeps the tooltip close to the pointer; Far moves it away from the pointer.

Editor.title: Editor and toolbar
Editor.html:
Settings tab: "Editor". Editing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Editor toolbaredt:toolbarThe bar above the editor. It holds the Save button, the background tone, the font and its size, the LLM button and the settings gear. Hiding the bar hides all of them.Yes
Save buttonedt:saveThe Save button. The left part saves at once (while AutoSave waits for a location, it asks for one). The arrow opens a menu with the AutoSave switch, Save As and Save All. The lamp shows the AutoSave state (green = saving, orange = waiting for a location, grey = off). Hiding this part hides the button and the arrow together.Save automatically (Linked), Save when typing pauses (Reflected), Save at each new line (Reflected)Yes (with a notice)
Background tone selectoredt:bg-toneEditor backgroundEditor background (Linked)Yes
Font menu (toolbar)edt:font-familyChoose the fontFont Family (Linked)Yes
Text size menu (toolbar)edt:font-sizeChoose the text sizeFont Size (Linked)Yes
Editor AI buttonedt:ai-toggleAI chat: click to switch on or off. When off: click turns it on and opens the chat dock. No model: opens SettingsUse AI chat (Linked)Yes
Editor settings gearedt:quick-settingsGo to the Editor tab of the settings pageYes
Document tabsedt:tab-barThe tabs of the open documents. Right-click a tab to duplicate it; the + button opens a new document. A tab with unsaved changes always asks before it closes.Yes (with a notice)
Undo buttonedt:undoUndo the last changeYes
Redo buttonedt:redoRedo the change you undidYes
Markdown preview buttonedt:markdown-previewShow or hide the rendered Markdown previewYes

Editor status baredt:status-barThe strip under the editor: character count, line count, encoding, the document format (Markdown and Text are shown side by side and either can be chosen; the chosen format sets the default file name and extension of a manual save) and the Markdown preview button.Yes
Document format switchedt:document-formatThe format of this document. Point at it to list Markdown and Text; the one you choose sets the file name and extension when you saveFormat of new documents (Linked)Yes
Document language switchedt:document-languageSwitches the language of the document. With Auto the language is decided from the lang: line at the top, then the share of kana in the text, then the UI language. The language sets the wrapping and word-separation defaults; options changed in Editor options stay as they are.Yes

Its header has the model button, the API key, clear history, save chat, the use switch, minimize, and a gear to the settings page. Switching off closes it. Minimize collapses it to the header bar. Chat dock: model buttonedt:llm-modelThe button of the model in use. Pressing it opens a short menu to pick the model in place. The long list (search and sorting) is in the Models tab of the log panel, opened by All models at the end of the menu.Model (Reflected)Yes
Chat dock: API key buttonedt:llm-key-configConfigure API KeyAPI Key (Linked)Yes
Chat dock: clear history buttonedt:llm-clear-chatClears the conversation. Asks for confirmation first. A cleared conversation cannot be restored; save it first with the save button if you want to keep it.Yes
Chat dock: save chat buttonedt:llm-export-chatThe save button of the chat dock. Writes the conversation to a Markdown file; the save dialog chooses where.Yes
Chat dock: move buttonedt:llm-moveMoves the chat area between below the editor and the right sidebar. It writes the same value as Chat position on the settings page. The conversation and the draft are kept.Chat position (Linked)Yes
Chat dock: use switchedt:llm-switchThe use switch in the chat area header. It is the same value as the title-bar AI button and Use AI chat on the settings page. Switching off closes the chat area; the conversation is not lost.Use AI chat (Linked)Yes
Chat dock: collapse buttonedt:llm-collapseMinimize or expand the chat dockYes
Chat dock: settings gearedt:llm-settingsThe gear button that opens AI chat (Editor tab) of the settings page. The detailed settings such as the provider, the API key and fetching models are set there.Yes

How it behaves

Save button (edt:save)

WhenThen
Lamp is greenAutoSave is on and the document has a file
Lamp is orangeAutoSave is on but the document has no file yet; typing is kept as a draft only
Lamp is greyAutoSave is off (the user turned it off)

Editor AI button (edt:ai-toggle)

WhenThen
The model is not set up (no key)Asks to confirm, then opens the LLM card on the Editor tab of the settings
LLM is offTurns LLM on and opens the chat dock. Embedding is not changed. Calls to Gemini and the like become possible
On right-clickOffers Open AI chat in the right sidebar and Open AI chat below the editor. Choosing one changes the place and, with the chat off, turns it on. The title-bar AI button, the chat area, the header switch and the move button all offer the same
LLM is onTurns LLM off and closes the chat dock. While off, chat, Ctrl+K, the right-click LLM chat and Gemini suggestions are unavailable. Embedding is not changed
When switchedShows the same sentence in a toast and in the log (for example [AI] LLM: ON → OFF)

Editor settings gear (edt:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the Editor tab of the settings page

Document list button (edt:tab-list)

WhenThen
When the document list button is pressedShows all open documents. Choosing one switches to it. With many documents the tab row scrolls sideways

Document format switch (edt:document-format)

WhenThen
HoverShows both formats (Markdown and Text) side by side and either can be chosen. The chosen format sets the default file name and extension in the manual save dialog (it can still be changed there)

Document language switch (edt:document-language)

WhenThen
HoverShows Auto, Japanese and English side by side and any can be chosen. Auto decides from the lang: line at the top of the document, then the share of kana in the text, then the UI language. The language chosen sets the wrapping and word-separation defaults for that document (options changed in Editor options are left alone)

AI chat (edt:llm-dock)

WhenThen
LLM is offCloses the chat dock and disables input, send and clear
Drag the top borderChanges the dock height. Double-click resets it. The height is remembered (can be turned off in the settings)
A question about the app (for example what Embedding is or whether the font can be changed)Puts the matching cards of the guide in front of the question and has the LLM answer within them. What the guide does not cover is answered with I do not know and a pointer to Settings or the Guide button. Other requests (such as rewriting a text) get nothing added
While waiting for a replyThe Send button becomes Stop. Pressing it cancels the send, says it was stopped, and puts the typed text back into the input box. Enter does not send a second message while waiting
Under the input boxAlways shows where the next message goes (service and model). It is the same as the model button and follows a change in the settings

Chat dock: model button (edt:llm-model)

WhenThen
When the model button is pressedOpens a short menu to pick the model in place. OpenAI and Claude show their fixed lists; Gemini shows up to 8 of the newest text models of the list already fetched. The model in use is always first. Choosing writes the same stored value as the settings page and the Models tab of the log panel, and the destination line follows. With no list it offers Fetch the model list. The last item All models opens the Models tab of the log panel. It does not open while a reply is awaited. With no provider chosen it opens the card of the settings page

Chat dock: API key button (edt:llm-key-config)

WhenThen
A key is storedShows only the last 4 characters. Empty means unchanged, typing overwrites, the delete button removes it. The key stays in the main process and is never sent back to the window

Chat dock: clear history button (edt:llm-clear-chat)

WhenThen
When Clear history is pressedAsks to confirm. Only Clear removes the conversation from the window; it cannot be restored

Chat dock: save chat button (edt:llm-export-chat)

WhenThen
When Save chat is pressed with a conversationOpens the save dialog and writes the conversation as a Markdown file
When Save chat is pressed with no conversationSays there is no conversation yet; no file is written

Chat dock: move button (edt:llm-move)

WhenThen
When the move button is pressedMoves the chat area to the other place (below the editor <-> right sidebar). The place is remembered as the Chat position setting, also for the next start. The conversation and the draft are kept

Chat dock: use switch (edt:llm-switch)

WhenThen
When the header switch is pressedTurns Use AI chat off and closes the chat area. It is the same value as the title-bar AI button and the settings row, and all follow each other. The conversation stays in the window; turning it on again shows the same conversation

Chat dock: collapse button (edt:llm-collapse)

WhenThen
When Minimize is pressedCollapses the chat area to its header bar. It stays on, and the switch and the gear on the bar still work. Pressing again expands it. There is no on-but-hidden state

Chat dock: settings gear (edt:llm-settings)

WhenThen
When the gear is pressedOpens the AI chat card (Editor tab) of the settings page. It works like the gears of the other areas; the detailed settings that are not here are set there

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window

What stops working when hidden

Hiding these parts shows a notice. The eye button brings them back.

PartWhen hidden
Save buttonThe save button is hidden. The autosave LED and the save menu are not shown.
Document tabsThe document tabs are hidden. You cannot switch between open documents.

Sidebar.title: Suggestion sidebar
Sidebar.html:
Settings tab: "Sidebar". Knowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Suggestion sidebarsbr:sidebarDrag to resize the sidebarYes (with a notice)
Panel open/close buttonsbr:panel-toggleCollapse / Expand SidebarOpen on selection (Reflected)Yes
Embedding on/off buttonsbr:embedding-toggleEmbedding assistant: click to turn real-time semantic suggestions on or offEmbedding model (Linked), EMBEDDING MODELS (Reflected)Yes
Sidebar settings gearsbr:quick-settingsGo to the Sidebar tab of the settings pageYes
Sidebar: Collection tabsbr:tab-collectionThe tab that shows Collection (guidelines, knowledge, results) in the right sidebar. It appears only while the chat is placed in the sidebar.Yes
Sidebar: AI chat tabsbr:tab-chatThe tab that shows the AI chat in the right sidebar. A dot means the chat is on; the tab is emphasized when a reply arrives while another tab is shown. It appears only while the chat is placed in the sidebar.Chat position (Linked)Yes
Change embedding model buttonsbr:embedding-model-changeThe button on the row of the embedding model in use. It opens the model list of the settings page, where the model is changed.Yes
Collection headingsbr:collectionEmbedding and the LLM both use neural-network technology, but they produce different things. Embedding turns the meaning of a text into a list of numbers (a vector) and writes no new text; it is used to find texts with a similar meaning. The LLM reads a text and writes new text (an answer or a rewrite). Guidelines and Knowledge run on the embedding model.Yes
Guidelines cardsbr:guideline-cardThe card for the active guideline (preset). Click to open or close it. You can insert a template, add files and unload the loaded guideline (this only detaches the file and deletes no data).Yes (with a notice)
Import dictionary buttonsbr:import-dictionaryAdd Knowledge filesAdd files (Linked)Yes
Knowledge slots cardsbr:knowledge-cardThe card for the knowledge slots. Click to open or close it. Add files to add slots and detach a file with the X of its row. With two or more slots an Unload All button also appears (it only detaches files and deletes no data; it always asks to confirm). A badge shows how many slots are loaded. With LLM on and Embedding off Gemini suggestions appear in addition to the dictionary search.Yes (with a notice)
Add knowledge slot buttonsbr:add-slotAdd Knowledge SlotYes
Minimum score field (sidebar)sbr:score-filterMinimum similarity score for suggestions (50% - 99%)Similarity threshold (%) (Linked)Yes
Result limit menu (sidebar)sbr:limit-selectMaximum number of suggestionsResult limit (Linked)Yes
Full metadata checkbox (sidebar)sbr:metadata-toggleShow full metadata and attributes in suggestion resultsShow full metadata (Linked)Yes
Metadata field checkboxes (sidebar)sbr:metadata-fieldsOne checkbox per field name found in the results (such as definition or facet). Only the ticked fields appear in the detail table of each card. With Full Metadata on, every field is shown and these checkboxes cannot be changed. Field names come from the result data, and the ticked state is saved.Yes
Editor options cardsbr:editor-options-cardThe card that lists every Monaco editor option. Click to expand or collapse. The search box filters by name or description; the Show changed only button beside it shows just the options you changed (press again for all). Changing an option updates the main editor at once and is saved with the settings. A changed option gets a coloured bar and a ↺ button that restores that option alone; the button in the card header restores them all. Options the settings page already owns (font, word wrap, line numbers and so on) are read-only here. See MONACO_OPTIONS.md for the full list.Editor options (Reflected)Yes
Collapsed sidebar railsbr:railThe narrow column of icons that appears while the sidebar is collapsed. It has the expand, Guidelines and Knowledge buttons.Yes

Panel open/close button (sbr:panel-toggle)

WhenThen

System.title: Bottom bar and system
System.html:
Settings tab: "System". The log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Log panel: Log tabsys:log-tab-logThe Log tab of the log panel. Shows the list of system log entries.Yes
Log panel: Models tabsys:log-tab-modelsThe Models tab of the log panel. Fetches the Gemini model list and chooses the model to use. The choice is the same as on the settings page.Yes
Log panel: clear buttonsys:log-clearClear all log entries from the panelSystem log (Linked)Yes
Log panel: copy buttonsys:log-copyCopy all log entries to the clipboardSystem log (Linked)Yes
Log panel: save buttonsys:log-downloadSave all log entries to a text fileSystem log (Linked)Yes
Log panel: Fetch Models buttonsys:log-models-fetchFetches the Gemini model list with the saved key and shows it in the list.Yes
Bottom barsys:bottom-barThe bar at the bottom of the window: the log button, the pipeline state, the System settings gear, the update notice, the save result and the memory use.Yes (with a notice)
Log panelsys:log-consoleOpen or close the log panelOpen log panel at startup (Reflected), Remember layout (Reflected), Log time format (Reflected), Log time zone (Reflected)Yes
Status info (characters, lines, encoding)sys:status-metaShows how much memory (RAM) the app uses.Yes
Pipeline status LEDssys:pipeline-meterSeven lamps for the startup state: 1 Config, 2 Theme, 3 Locale, 4 Editor, 5 Rust engine, 6 AI model, 7 Knowledge base (HNSW). Point at a lamp for details. Green means ready, orange means preparing, grey means switched off on purpose or not loaded, red means an error. Standby on the AI model and the knowledge base only means not loaded yet; it is not a fault. Click an orange, grey or red lamp to jump to where it is fixed (an error on 5 Rust engine opens the Help entry for when the Rust engine does not load).Yes
System settings gearsys:quick-settingsGo to the System tab of the settings pageYes

How it behaves

Log panel: Models tab (sys:log-tab-models)

WhenThen
When the Models tab is chosenShows the model list. The chosen model is the same as on the settings page

Log time formatHow each log time is shown. Only the display changes; the stored time is always the same. Examples for 16:47:01 UTC: 24 hours: 16:47:01. 12 hours: 04:47:01 PM. Follow OS: the format of your Windows region. ISO 8601: 2026-10-25T16:47:01.123Z (always UTC).ReflectedLog panel
Log time zoneThe time zone of the log times. Local shows this computer's time zone (the default). UTC shows Coordinated Universal Time. ISO 8601 is always UTC, whatever this is set to.ReflectedLog panel
Log languageThe language of the log lines. English (the default) keeps every log the same whatever the app language is, which suits sharing it. Follow app language writes new lines in the app language. Lines already written stay as they are.
Log fileChoose how the log is kept. Ask when exiting asks each time you quit. Always save keeps every session for 30 days. Do not save keeps nothing.
Saved logsPick a saved session to read it below. Sessions older than 30 days are removed when the app starts.
Remember layoutRemembers the height of the log panel and the chat dock and the width of the sidebar, and restores them at the next start. Turning it off forgets them.ReflectedLog panel

Application Maintenance

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Reload Editor WindowRedraws the editor window only; the app keeps running. Use this when the screen looks wrong or after a UI change. Nothing is deleted.Settings only
Restart ApplicationCloses the whole app and starts it again, including the engine and background processes. Use this after an update or when the engine or a model stops responding. Settings, documents, cached models, Knowledge Slots, and the encrypted API keys are kept.Settings only
Clear Application CacheClears Electron session cache and temporary renderer resources. It does not delete documents, Knowledge Slots, settings, downloaded model files, or API keys.Settings only
Restore all settingsResets everything to the first-run state: preferences, the loaded KNOWLEDGE and guideline, the API keys and the downloaded models. The first-run setup shows again. Pressing it asks for confirmation first.Settings only
Dev resetSame as the reset above, but keeps the model files, the API keys, the loaded KNOWLEDGE and guideline, and the save folder. The first-run setup shows again. A confirmation appears first.Settings only
